about: The 2021 census as counted in its own SA1 statistical areas — the Areas drawing's pack on /map/. National SA1 geometry (ABS digital boundaries, simplified 8% planar keep-shapes, 1e5 quantisation) plus the Census lens's measures as per-SA1 lanes in geometry order. Bases mirror the map's other census stores (gcp_newlanes formulas, ex-not-stated denominators); ageMed/incMed are the GCP G02's own printed medians; SEIFA lanes are the ABS's published national SA1 deciles 1-10 (0 = not published). The income quartile lanes (loinc/hiqinc) are cut-relative: meta.incBands carries each SA1's sixteen adults-basis band masses and the share is computed at draw time against the frame in view's own cuts, exactly as its seat stores do. Lane encoding t: u8x2 = share ×200 (255 null), u8 = uint8 (255 null), u8z = uint8 (0 null), u16 = uint16-le (65535 null), u16x16 = sixteen uint16-le per SA1, u32/u32x100 = uint32-le (area ×100). caps are each key's extents (shares: population-weighted p99.5 rounded up nice; seifa 1-10); marks are the pooled jurisdiction benchmarks the legend's lines ride (income lanes priced at each universe's own cuts).
